name: Hip Openers
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lift one knee and circle it out to the side and back down.
Repeat 8 to 10 times on each leg.
Keep your standing leg stable and your torso upright.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A sequence of dynamic movements that mobilise the hips in multiple directions.
